# Pixelate transition

Breaks the image into ever larger blocks, switches to the next image at the coarsest point, then sharpens back down to single pixels.

<EffectDemo effect="pixelate-transition" />

## Usage

```ts
import { createTransition, toHoloEffect } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { pixelateTransition } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/pixelate-transition';

const effect = pixelateTransition({ preset: 'chunky' });

// Standalone: blend two textures as progress goes from 0 to 1.
const player = createTransition(renderer, effect, {
  from: textureA,
  to: textureB,
});
player.progress = 0.5;
player.render();

// With HoloCSS: hand it to transition3d().
import { transition3d } from '@mk7s/holocss/three';
await transition3d(fromElement, toElement, toHoloEffect(effect), {
  target,
  update,
});
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.maxCell = 48`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter    | Type   | Default | Range      | Description                                                                     |
| ------------ | ------ | ------- | ---------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `maxCell`    | number | `48`    | 2 – 256 px | Block size at the middle of the transition.                                     |
| `curve`      | number | `1.5`   | 0.25 – 4   | How the blocks grow: above 1 they stay small longer, below 1 they grow quickly. |
| `switchTime` | number | `0.2`   | 0 – 1      | How much of the transition the switch between images takes; 0 cuts.             |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset   | Settings                                     |
| -------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| `chunky` | `maxCell: 96`, `curve: 1`                    |
| `cut`    | `switchTime: 0`                              |
| `gentle` | `maxCell: 24`, `switchTime: 0.5`, `curve: 2` |

Apply one with `pixelateTransition({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Transitions · tracked as story X13.5 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Kind:** transition. `createTransition(renderer, effect, { from, to })` runs it on two textures; `toHoloEffect(effect)` turns it into a HoloCSS `ThreeEffect` (parameters are baked in when called), with the `hcss-depth` CSS fallback. See [transitions](/guide/transitions).
- **Motion:** driven by `progress` from your timeline. HoloCSS skips transitions when motion is off; standalone, set `progress = 1` instead of animating.
- **Size:** 5.8 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/pixelate-transition`, including the shared effect runtime.

## Credits

Original implementation (MIT). References: Cell size following sin(πt), switching images at the coarsest point.

## Related

- [Pixelate](./pixelate) — Big square, hexagonal or round pixels, each the color at its center.
- [Glitch cut](./glitch-cut) — Cuts to the next image through digital damage: blocks flip over one by one around the middle while slices shift and the color channels split.
- [Crossfade & luma wipe](./crossfade) — Blends to the next image everywhere at once, through noise, or along a luma pattern (linear, radial, diamond or spiral) with a soft edge that can glow in the theme accent.
